up: Find all compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1133765. A compound is considered reported in the document if it is linked through the compound_records table to that document. For each such compound, retrieve: its ChEMBL identifier (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), its maximum development phase (molecule_dictionary.max_phase), its molecule type (molecule_dictionary.molecule_type), and its canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Order the results by the compound's ChEMBL ID in ascending order. Do not apply any additional filters or limits.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  md.max_phase,
  md.molecule_type,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1133765'
ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
